statement_summary: Program documented in policies, standards, and the SSP
IT Director designated security officer and PCI DSS owner; CFO signs the AOC
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment and PCI targeted risk analyses
Risk acceptance authority; no card data or food safety risk above Low after treatment
Quarterly reporting to the audit committee
Annual policy and standard review
Written, time-limited exceptions; no PCI waiver without a QSA-reviewed compensating control
Sanctions
PCI DSS scope, data flows, and inventory confirmed every 12 months and on change
TPSP and vendor terms, AOCs, responsibility matrix, annual check; purchasing gate
Annual independent evaluation; QSA separate from internal audit
Retention of security records for at least 3 years
AI tools approved through AI governance before use
Privacy, security, savings, and pricing claims reviewed before publication
Privacy review before any new use or sharing of customer data
Unique accounts; no shared vendor or virtual terminal accounts
Role-based least-privilege access with approval
MFA for all access and into the CDE; phishing-resistant MFA for administrators
Identity provider and POS access disabled on the last day
Prior-role access removed within 5 business days of transfer
Quarterly privileged reviews; all accounts at least every 6 months
Separate privileged accounts; just-in-time elevation; CDE admin only through the broker
Lockout, screen lock, and session timeouts
Break-glass accounts tested quarterly
Password rules; vendor defaults changed; credentials vaulted and rotated
Vendor remote access through the broker, per-session approval, recorded
No unapproved devices or connections on company networks
Runbooks for e-commerce skimming and ransomware
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour, including PIN pad tampering and fraud complaints
Log incidents with time of suspicion and determination
Crisis management team within 2 hours for severity 1
Acquirer notice within 24 hours of suspected card compromise
Breach determination and decision log; notices per the matrix
Insurer hotline before engaging vendors
Ransom approval, OFAC check, law enforcement report
No resumption of card acceptance until containment is verified
Annual exercise per runbook, including the acquirer contact
24x7 monitoring of CDE security control alerts
Lessons learned within 30 days
Four classification levels
Card data captured only on approved channels; no card data on paper, email, or chat; no SAD after authorization
Encryption at rest and in transit for Restricted data
Key management with separate backup keys
Restricted data only in approved systems
Customer data used only as the privacy notice says; review before new sharing
Data inventory and flow maps reconciled quarterly
Cross-cut shredding; certificates for media and POS hardware
Encrypted, isolated, restore-tested backups; store server images off-site
Retention limits for loyalty history and closed accounts
No Restricted data in unapproved AI tools
Supplier data separated and tested yearly
Business use of company systems
Acknowledgment at hire and yearly
Yearly training for all staff; phishing simulations; role-based training
Lock screens; do not leave the virtual terminal open
No unapproved software or devices
Managed devices only
Report anything unusual immediately
PIN pad inspections and verification of service visits
Never collect card numbers aloud, on paper, or by email or chat
Approved AI tools only; human check of outputs
